title: PET STORE & ZOO VLOG + KANSAS CITY MEETUP
description:
Random vlog while shopping at some local pet stores for hermit crab items, and a little trip to the zoo! If you're in the Kansas City area make sure to sign up for Strutt with your Mutt on September 17th so we can walk together! If you aren't in the area I'd still love if you could donate to help a great cause!
